svg.text: From a .zip package to a running payload in 7 steps.
Follow the same steps to build the update into your own application.
Prepare and upload · the payload is not changed yet
md5sum on the PC = md5sum on the payload
Tip: upload as .zip.part, rename to .zip after the md5 check.
Saved as BOOT_A (a new value after every reboot)
Reboot and install · do not power off the payload
# every 1 s, same command as step 2
boot_id ≠ BOOT_A → save it as BOOT_B
ssh errors while the payload reboots are normal: keep trying.
# every 1 s, use only the lines after the last "Start Apply OTA"
log has: do_apply_ota.lock has been successfully deleted
Percent and result: see the log table below.
"Skipping firmware update as expected" is OK, not an error.
# every 1 s, same command as step 2
a heartbeat comes from MAV_COMP_ID_CAMERA ... CAMERA6
New software is running. Exit code 0. Any STOP IF → exit code 1.
Check each line of the last run with "contains". Keep the highest percent seen.
Split the text by \n and by \r (the gimbal flashing line ends with \r).
a new run starts (read the last run)
Gimbal FW update not selected. Skip
Payload file not found in /sdcard after
error line: show it to the user
Failed component = started (Found do_install.sh) without "Successfully executed",
or with "Failed to execute", and not skipped.
